title: suregada subglomerata
intro: Suregada subglomerata, commonly known as Indian olive, is a plant species that belongs to the family Euphorbiaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in various cultures to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Suregada subglomerata include reducing inflammation, fighting bacterial and fungal infections, and exhibiting antipyretic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
